# Concurso 36/2012 triangle · Control 21 / 22 / 24 continuity protocol — 4 Sep 2026

**Control ID:** `PD-C36-TRI-001`  
**Status:** **MANDATORY CONTINUITY GOVERNANCE**  
**Scope:** Concurso Ordinario 36/2012 and every public or canonical derivative that uses Control 21, Control 22, Control 24, DP 1901/2026, DP 1956/2026, the insolvency administrator, the Concurso judge, CGPJ 169/2026 / Alzada 286/2026, Fiscalía/DIP 2/2026, ICALPA DIP 80/2026, AC separation/remuneration appeals or RPL 2523/2025.

## 1. Permanent architecture

Every successor thread, agent, page generator, search index and evidence-graph maintenance pass must preserve this architecture:

```text
Concurso Ordinario 36/2012
│
├── CONTROL 21 / NEXUS 36 / DP 1901/2026
│   └── PRIVATE-ACTOR LAYER
│
├── CONTROL 22
│   └── ADMINISTRADOR CONCURSAL LAYER
│       ├── DP 1956/2026
│       ├── ICALPA DIP 80/2026
│       ├── separación/removal proceedings
│       └── remuneration/fees appeals
│
├── CONTROL 24 / GC-HC-010
│   └── JUDGE / JUDICIAL-ACTION LAYER
│       ├── complaint filed 18 June 2026 · Decanato daily no. 24
│       ├── 25 June 2026 supplement/ampliación
│       ├── CGPJ DI 169/2026
│       ├── Recurso de alzada 286/2026 and related ampliación material
│       ├── Fiscalía / DIP 2/2026 relationship
│       └── querella / other judge-directed route where filing status is source-proved
│
├── CALIFICACIÓN → RPL 2523/2025
├── AC SEPARATION / REMUNERATION → corresponding appeals
└── RELATED OVERSIGHT ROUTES → Fiscalía · CGPJ · professional discipline · other competent fora
```

The three accountability vertices are:

`PRIVATE ACTORS ↔ ADMINISTRADOR CONCURSAL ↔ CONCURSO JUDGE`

Fiscalía is an institutional/prosecutorial perimeter, **not a fourth vertex**. Any proposition that Fiscalía was neutralised, bypassed, rendered ineffective, captured, or failed to act is a reporting-party allegation or reasoned inference unless and until a competent determination or direct source establishes the narrower proposition stated.

## 2. One graph, separate proceedings

The project maintains one evidence/relationship graph while preserving separate legal and procedural identities.

Mandatory rule:

> `INTERLINK ≠ MERGE` and `SHARED SOURCE ≠ SHARED LIABILITY`.

No relationship edge may transfer knowledge, intent, causation, participation, criminality, guilt, liability, procedural status or adjudicated effect from one person/proceeding to another.

Every material edge must carry an epistemic/procedural state such as `DOCUMENTED`, `ATTRIBUTED_ALLEGATION`, `REASONED_INFERENCE`, `OPEN`, `CONTRARY` or `ADVERSE_OUTCOME`.

## 3. Control 24 canonical lock

`CONTROL-24` and Master Proceedings record `GC-HC-010` are the canonical judge-complaint identity pair.

Controlled facts as at 4 Sep 2026:

- complaint/notitia concerning the Concurso judge filed at the Decanato on **18 June 2026**;
- daily registration / intake locator **no. 24**;
- current judicial allocation, custodian and outcome **unknown**;
- 25 June 2026 material is recorded as a supplement/ampliación connected to Control 24 subject to its own joinder/electronic-metadata gaps;
- the filing was subsequently reported into the CGPJ 169/2026 / appeal-governance perimeter, but that relationship does not merge the criminal/notitia route with CGPJ supervision;
- `Control 24` is **not** a NIG, Diligencias Previas number, reparto, formal querella, admission, investigation, referral or outcome.

All future pages and indexes referring to the 18 June judge complaint must resolve to the same canonical object and expose the `GC-HC-010` cross-reference.

## 4. Control 22 bridge lock

`CONTROL-22` is a filing locator/complaint record. `DP 1956/2026` is a separate judicial proceeding identity.

The current graph may state that later controlled project material associates the Control 22 complaint with DP 1956/2026, but until the primary reparto/allocation bridge is produced it must retain an explicit `OFFICIAL_BRIDGE_COPY_REQUIRED` or equivalent gap.

Never silently rewrite `Control 22 = DP 1956/2026`.

## 5. Control 21 / DP 1901 lock

Control 21 / NEXUS 36 / DP 1901/2026 is the private-actor vertex. The project must preserve the precise source basis for any bridge among the intake locator, NEXUS 36 label and DP 1901/2026. The existence of a common factual nucleus does not make the private-actor route the AC or Judge route.

If a 25 June document is encountered, first determine whether it belongs to the Control 21/private-actor lane or to the separate Control 24 judge supplement. Same-date documents must never be merged by date alone.

## 6. Mandatory bidirectional interlinks

Where the route exists, maintain reciprocal navigation and graph edges for:

### Judge vertex
`Concurso 36/2012 ↔ Judge ↔ Control 24/GC-HC-010 ↔ 25-Jun supplement ↔ CGPJ DI 169/2026 ↔ Alzada 286/2026/ampliación material ↔ Fiscalía/DIP 2/2026 ↔ querella lane (status-bounded)`.

### AC vertex
`Concurso 36/2012 ↔ AC ↔ Control 22 ↔ DP 1956/2026 ↔ ICALPA DIP 80/2026 ↔ separation/removal ↔ remuneration/fees appeals`.

### Private-actor vertex
`Concurso 36/2012 ↔ Control 21/NEXUS 36 ↔ DP 1901/2026 ↔ private-actor pages/events/evidence`.

### Cross-vertex edges
Maintain typed links for private actors↔AC, AC↔Judge and Judge↔private actors where supported by common documents/events, while preserving actor-specific bridges and alternatives.

## 7. RPL 2523/2025 and parallel-life rule

RPL 2523/2025 is the calificación merits/nullity/defence appeal arising from Concurso 36/2012. It is part of the common nucleus graph but remains legally distinct from criminal, disciplinary, prosecutorial and governance routes. No public triangle presentation may imply that a criminal or disciplinary allegation is evidence in the appeal unless it is actually in that appeal record and lawfully relied upon there.

## 8. Fiscalía perimeter wording

Public visualisations may show Fiscalía/DIP 2/2026 on the perimeter and may state that the reporting party alleges institutional neutralisation, non-response, ineffective handling or enablement **only with explicit attribution**. The visual must not state institutional criminality, capture or collusion as adjudicated fact.

Preferred labels:

- ES: `Fiscalía / perímetro de supervisión — rutas separadas; neutralización alegada por el denunciante`.
- EN: `Prosecution / oversight perimeter — separate routes; neutralisation alleged by the reporting party`.

## 11. Continuity / successor-thread rule

A successor thread working on any vertex must first read:

1. `CHATGPT_START_HERE.md`;
2. this protocol;
3. `data/concurso-36-2012-triangle-register-v1.json`;
4. `.github/governance/ACTOR_EVENT_MULTITRACK_INTERLINKING_AND_PRECURSOR_PROTOCOL_01SEP2026.md`;
5. `.github/governance/AUTOMATIC_WORKSPACE_PERSISTENCE_ARCHITECTURE_01SEP2026.md`;
6. the current triangle handoff under `archive/handoffs/`.

A material update to one vertex triggers a cross-link review of the other two vertices plus the Fiscalía/CGPJ/disciplinary perimeter. Do not wait for a separate user request to preserve those relationships.

## 12. Governance failure conditions

Treat any of the following as a continuity failure:

- Control 21, 22 or 24 disappears from a rendered or canonical architecture without a source-driven supersession;
- Control 24 loses the `GC-HC-010` cross-reference or is assigned an unsupported NIG/DP/reparto;
- Control 22 is stated as identical to DP 1956 without the primary bridge;
- the two possible 25 June lanes are merged by date alone;
- a page presents related routes as consolidated;
- a shared outcome transfers intent/liability across vertices;
- ICALPA DIP 80, AC separation/remuneration, CGPJ 169/286, DIP 2/2026 or RPL 2523/2025 becomes an orphan from the Concurso 36/2012 graph;
- the rendered site and canonical register disagree on status;
- search cannot recover the canonical identifiers/aliases above.

## 13. Automated validation

Run:

`python3 scripts/validate_concurso36_triangle_continuity.py`

The dedicated GitHub Actions workflow must fail if mandatory nodes, aliases, boundary language, cross-links or public triangle assets disappear.

## 14. Publication boundary

This protocol governs repository/public-site representation only. It does not authorise filing, service, email, portal submission, authority contact, disclosure of private sources or representation that any complaint has been admitted or proved.
